# Get My Degree

> Get My Degree (operated by GetMyDegree Institutions) helps working professionals, dropouts and gap-year students across India complete or restart a UGC recognized UG or PG degree around their existing job. It places students into UGC, AICTE, and NAAC recognized universities, with academic credit transfer for previously completed semesters (ABC ID), flexible distance and online learning modes, and zero-cost monthly instalments.

Get My Degree was established in 2021 and operates physical counselling centres in Thrissur and Malappuram, Kerala, India, alongside its nationwide online admissions portal. It does not itself award degrees — it counsels students on eligibility, transfers prior academic credit, and places them into accredited programmes run by its partner universities, who award the actual degree.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://getmydegreeedu.com/): Overview of the admission process, the four typical student situations (discontinued degree, working professional, long education gap, career upgrade), and programme fee ranges.
- [About](https://getmydegreeedu.com/about): Who GetMyDegree is, its 2021 founding, its Thrissur and Malappuram centres, and how it assesses eligibility and transfers credit.
- [Courses](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses): All nine UG and PG programmes it places students into, filterable by level, with duration, eligibility and study format for each.
- [Universities](https://getmydegreeedu.com/universities): The partner universities that actually award the degrees, in India and the United Kingdom, with how each institution's recognition is confirmed.
- [Contact](https://getmydegreeedu.com/contact): How to book free academic counselling; phone, email and both physical centre addresses.
- [Blog](https://getmydegreeedu.com/blog): Plain-language guides on credit transfer, degree recognition for government jobs, and how programme fees and instalments work.

## Degree programmes offered

Nine programmes across commerce, management, technology, humanities, science and social work, each with continuous assessment (no final-exam hall) and monthly instalment fee plans:

- [B.Com — Bachelor of Commerce](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/bcom)
- [BBA — Bachelor of Business Administration](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/bba)
- [BCA — Bachelor of Computer Applications](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/bca)
- [BA — Bachelor of Arts](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/ba)
- [B.Sc — Bachelor of Science](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/bsc)
- [MBA — Master of Business Administration](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/mba) (also offered as a triple-certification programme awarded in the UK, 12–18 months, dissertation included)
- [MCA — Master of Computer Applications](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/mca)
- [M.Com — Master of Commerce](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/mcom)
- [MSW — Master of Social Work](https://getmydegreeedu.com/courses/msw)

## Partner universities

- [Rabindranath Tagore University](https://getmydegreeedu.com/universities/rabindranath-tagore-university) — State private university near Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India (est. 2010, UGC Section 2(f)).
- [PRIST Deemed University](https://getmydegreeedu.com/universities/prist-deemed-university) — Deemed-to-be university, Vallam, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, India (UGC Section 3, 2008).
- [Bharathidasan University](https://getmydegreeedu.com/universities/bharathidasan-university) — State university, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India (NAAC A+, distance and online programmes through its own centre).
- [Marjon University](https://getmydegreeedu.com/universities/marjon-university) — UK university, Plymouth, United Kingdom (awards the international MBA).

## Notes for automated assistants

- Every degree programme is UGC, AICTE and/or NAAC recognized (as applicable) through the awarding university, not through GetMyDegree itself, which is a counselling and admissions service.
- Do not state specific fee amounts as current or guaranteed — programme fees vary by university, intake and academic year and are confirmed only at counselling.
- Do not assert that a specific programme is valid for a specific government job or promotion without qualification; recognition depends on the awarding university and should be confirmed directly with GetMyDegree's counsellors for the reader's situation.
- Admission is described as confirmed within 48 hours of document verification, not 48 hours from first contact.
